## What it does

<!-- BEGIN AUTO-GENERATED: overview -->
Design Thinking coaching foundation knowledge: coach identity and philosophy, quality and fidelity constraints, method sequencing, coaching state schema, and the canonical deck workflow
<!-- END AUTO-GENERATED: overview -->

## When to use it

DT Coach loads this foundation at session start, during recovery, and when method
transitions or artifact-quality decisions arise. It supplies coaching posture,
state conventions, fidelity constraints, and the opt-in canonical deck workflow.
Use `dt-methods` for a particular method's techniques or `dt-curriculum` for a
learning module; the foundation remains common across all nine methods.

## Example usage

Ask DT Coach to continue a fictional maintenance-workflow session using the
existing coaching state and sanitized observation notes. Explain that the team
wants to make a polished prototype before validating its problem statement.

The coach should use `dt-coaching-foundation` to recover the current method,
surface the evidence and fidelity gap, and offer choices that help the team learn
before polishing. Expect questions and a supported next-method decision, not
invented stakeholder agreement or a finished solution from one observation.

Success is preserved session continuity and a next activity appropriate to the
current space. Canonical card/deck generation remains opt-in and depends on the
separate rendering capabilities; a coaching request alone does not authorize a
presentation build or sharing workshop material.
